name: Error-Guided Adaptive Sampling (Bubbling)
definition: A training-phase sampling strategy that dynamically adjusts ray sampling density based on reconstruction error, specifically targeting missing or thin geometry during the 'bubble' step.
summary: Error-Guided Adaptive Sampling, or Bubbling, is a training-phase strategy that dynamically adjusts ray sampling density based on per-pixel reconstruction error to target missing geometry, distinguishing itself by maintaining a continuous PDF map and pruning low-error pixels.
